note: source_photo.png is the photo as sent. The maps come from its flattest area (rows 520-865), turned 17.5 deg so the ribs run level, lighting divided out (28 px blur), 420 x 196 px kept, mirrored 2 x 2 so it repeats without a seam. Colour = that relief times the Select | exterior mean linear colour (0.0088, 0.0594, 0.0237) baked from Final Blender/Perhaps_Select_Box.blend; height = the relief. rib_jacquard_black_color.png: the same relief times black (0.012, 0.0115, 0.011). rib_jacquard_normal_gl.png: OpenGL normal map from the height at 35 % of the 0.16 mm render relief (for the GLB; web viewers light it harder). rib_jacquard_navy_color.png: the same relief times a near-black midnight navy (0.0028, 0.0042, 0.0165). rib_jacquard_bottle_green_color.png: the same relief times bottle green (0.0195, 0.0401, 0.029), the central-80 % mean of green_reference_photo.png (a dark green leather photo supplied as the colour reference, #263830). rib_jacquard_deep_green_color.png: the relief at half contrast (1 + 0.5 (r - 1), a thinner rib) times a very dark bottle green (0.0035, 0.0125, 0.0068), Sleeve Lock v010. rib_jacquard_deep_navy_color.png: the same full relief times the Arc Band v011 render navy (0.0017, 0.0027, 0.0162), for its GLB.
